title: Produce date component audit sheet
description: Audit the date filter as an individual native date/range component with validation, from/to behavior, and browser-limit contracts.
objective: Define date filtering anatomy, invalid states, native picker limits, and safe customization before any implementation.
acceptance_criteria: From input, to input, label, placeholder, native picker, invalid range, focus, disabled, and responsive behavior are treated as separate subelements.
Native date picker limitations are documented instead of ignored.
The audit does not implement date fixes yet.
verification: No plugin source changes are made.

budgets.context_budget: date render, field CSS, frontend JS
budgets.research_budget: local source plus native-control notes if needed

risks: Native date behavior can vary by browser and platform.
Range validation can stay invisible unless the audit defines invalid states.
